resources.string: Full backups include original photos, saved points, recorded routes and their links. Changes are backed up while Fiskentra is running after you enable backup. Completed copies stay in your account; deleting something on this phone does not erase earlier backups. Unfinished tracks restore as saved routes without starting recording.
Point details can also sync separately. Use a full backup to recover photos, trips and point links on another phone. Records linked to a different account stay separate.
